site.name: Illinois Mine
site.location: Northwest of Nederland / Boulder County Tungsten District
overview: Illinois Mine was a documented tungsten mine northwest of Nederland and one of the principal properties operated by the Wolf Tongue Mining Company in the Boulder County tungsten district.

timeline.text: Wolf Tongue Mining Company operated the Illinois Mine as one of its principal tungsten properties near Nederland.
U.S. Geological Survey Professional Paper 245 documented the Illinois workings and their place within the Boulder County tungsten district.

moreHistory: State and federal mining records place the Illinois Mine roughly northwest of Nederland and document substantial underground workings, including a deep shaft and multiple levels.
The mine formed part of the tungsten-producing landscape around Nederland that became nationally important during the first half of the twentieth century.
